items.stem: Which TWO are legitimate pricing structure tactics? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Good-better-best tiering to serve different willingness to pay
options.rationale: Correct: tiers capture varied value segments.

options.text: Bundling complementary products to raise perceived value
options.rationale: Correct: bundles can increase value capture.

options.text: Hiding the price until after delivery
options.rationale: That erodes trust, not a tactic.

options.text: Charging every customer a secret different price with no logic

items.explanation: Correct: tiers capture varied value segments.
